    Souls

    ⚔️ The Reincarnation — The Two Heroes¶

    The Prophecy¶

    When the tree spirits spoke to Nethra, they gave her more than a device. They gave her a prophecy:

    Two heroes shall rise from the trees and reveal the lies about this world and the entire universe.

    The Mechanism¶

    The prophecy describes a specific reincarnation — the one exception to the rule that souls do not return as individuals. The quintillions of innocent souls consumed by the Hybrians across 3,000,000 years of war did not dissolve quietly into the substrate. Their collective will — a scale of suffering unmatched in universal history — refused to disperse. It accumulated. It waited.

    When it finally reached critical mass, it did not perform a single miracle. It performed a directed reincarnation: two souls from the Earth era, selected for their capabilities and character, were pulled across time and space into new bodies on Ge'or. They were chosen because they possessed the traits most necessary to oppose the Hybrians — not raw power, but the specific combination of will, clarity, and moral conviction that the deceased souls recognized as their own.

    These two are the heroes of the FDVR narrative — the ones who will expose the lies.

    Why Earth?¶

    The souls chose Earth-era humans because Earth was untouched by the Last Great War. No Hybrian infiltration. No mage-cell dilution. No cultural memory of defeat. The two selected were the most capable individuals of their time — not because they were the strongest, but because they were the most right.

    🔗 Connections to Other Systems¶

    Mage-Cells vs. Soul-Will¶

    System Substrate Mechanism Timescale
    Mage-Cells DNA — inherited Energy conversion Generations
    Soul-Will Consciousness — accumulated Will accumulation Millennia+

    Both are biological. Both operate within physics. Neither is supernatural.

    The Shadows' Exploitation¶

    The Shadows understand the soul-will mechanism better than any other faction on Ge'or. The Sacrifice Ceremony was not a one-time ritual — it was a proof of concept. If one man's soul (Kirivis) can be bound to a flesh-container (the Leviathan), then larger-scale applications are possible. The Shadows' ultimate goal may involve exploiting the accumulated soul-will of their victims — a possibility the Ironcloak consider their most urgent concern.
